description: Add a project under a client, with an hourly rate in the client's currency (its own, else the account's) and whether it is billable.

billable.description: Whether the time goes on invoices (default true)

client.description: Client id or exact client name

hourly_rate.description: Amount per hour in the client's currency (its own, else the account's), e.g. 85 or 62.5 (default 0)

name: create_project
title: Create a project
